note: Session 153 (#357 study step 4): Eurostat labelled set for the table-scoped parser, same shape and rules as benchmark/tableparse-labelled-set.json. Tables are 'eurostat:<code>' and are laid out by the production structure reader from tests/fixtures/eurostat-structure/. Labels are scored AFTER the code's seasonal rule (an s_adj the reading leaves open is filled from the period: month/quarter → SCA, else SA; year → NSA). Run: npm run tableparse:eval -- --eurostat [--replay|--record].
